messages:
sam: quick heads-up — Cascade Health wants a trial next week. I set a proposed Day0 for Tue 2026-06-15 10:00 PT. Need to lock agenda, success criteria, and security handoff notes.
anya: +1. can we get their primary use-case clarified before day0? Is this extraction + summarization or full chart-generation?
sam: their PM says two pilots: 1) discharge summary drafting (priority) 2) coding assistance for notes (secondary). We should scope both but focus eval on 1.
lee: for discharge summary eval, we need a prompt set + 20 golden examples. Ask customer to provide deidentified notes or we can use synthetic. Also need seq len estimates (avg tokens).
priya: tagging stakeholders: @Cascade PM = Mira, infra lead = Tom, security = Elena. I'll ask them for golden examples and an intake form.
jamal: security checklist — they asked about data-in-flight encryption, isolation, and whether we can deploy on their VPC. Cascade requires SOC2 + HIPAA controls. We'll need their security questionnaire filled; can we provide our standard SSO/SAML docs and VPC pattern?
anya: action items for Day0: 1) Introductions/stakeholders 2) Success criteria & pass/fail 3) Data plan (sample exchange & redaction) 4) Runbook for evals & metrics 5) Timeline & billing 6) Blockers & next steps
lee: technical asks: will they allow uploading a 10–20 doc corpus for eval batch? we should propose streaming vs batch inference for throughput estimates.
alice: pricing note — for a short pilot (<30 days) we can offer evaluation credits, but dedicated throughput or private deployment will need a committed quote. Need to surface expected qps/tokens so we can model cost.
sam: Mira (customer) asked about prompt engineering support. We should offer 2 tune sessions from solutions + 2 eval iterations. Put that in scope.
priya: success criteria suggestion: 1) Avg ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on 20 holdout discharge summaries OR clinician acceptance >= 75% on sampled outputs; 2) P95 latency < 1.5s per request for interactive edits; 3) No PII leakage in audit samples. Thoughts?
jamal: add security gating: signed BAA, encrypted-at-rest + customer-managed KMS for private deployments, and SSO configuration completed before any production data. Until BAA is signed, only deidentified data or synthetic test sets.
anya: prompt eval snippet to ask for from customer (copy/paste):
```
System: You are a clinical summarization assistant.
User: Summarize the following discharge note into a concise 4–6 bullet summary emphasizing diagnosis, follow-up, and meds.
Assistant: <expected style>
```
Include 20 examples like this.
lee: operational note: we need sequence length distribution and a sample of tokenized notes so kernel selection/quant profiles can be estimated. If they can't provide tokens, sample char counts will do.
sam: blockers to confirm pre-Day0: TOM (infra) — VPC access window? ELENA (security) — timeline for questionnaire? MIRA (PM) — will they produce the 20 golden examples by EOD Mon?
priya: I'll ping them now.
calendar-bot: Event created: Cascade Health — Trial Onramp — Tue Jun 15 10:00 PT (organizer: sam).
anya: prep doc: I'll draft a one-pager with agenda, asks, and eval checklist. Will post a link here when ready.
alice: sales ops: if they request private deployment during pilot, escalate to AE for an early pricing sketch — we should schedule a pricing sync after Day0.
lee: also add monitoring: token-level cost dashboard and QA sampling process. We'll include tracing hooks in the eval.
sam: perfect. Owners: Sam = AE lead, Anya = Solutions owner, Lee = Eng runbook, Jamal = Security contact, Priya = CS. Next: Priya to confirm stakeholders and whether they can deliver examples by Mon EOD.
priya: confirmed — ping sent. will update thread with answers. :phone:
